name: Markov Manor
description: Markov Manor is Sorin Markov's ancestral home on Innistrad, where he has been unwelcome for centuries.

description_citations.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

summary.text: Markov Manor is Sorin Markov's ancestral home on Innistrad, where he has been unwelcome for centuries.

citations.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

bio.text: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse than the other leads, but Jace insists it is his best lead, and he later tells Liliana of the moonfolk journal he found there.

citations.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.
"Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

bio.text: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

bio.text: Jenrik did not survive Markov Manor, as Jace tells Tamiyo.

citations.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

bio.text: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at the manor for Sorin.

citations.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

status.text: The manor is Sorin's ruined castle in the latest stories, where the wounded recover after the battle against Olivia.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's magic tears Markov Manor from its mountain perch.
timeline.quote: torn from its mountain perch and left floating above Stensia by Nahiri 's magic.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most vampires revile Sorin as a traitor for creating Avacyn and he is no longer welcome at Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: Some of the vampires understood Sorin's act, but most reviled him as a traitor.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Freed from the Helvault, Nahiri finds Zendikar ravaged, swears vengeance on Sorin and destroys Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor in ruins and seeks help from Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: His search brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri wounds and encases Sorin in stone at Markov Manor and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was wounded severely but managed to encase Sorin in stone.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse, but Jace insists it is his best lead.
timeline.quote: Markov Manor is the best lead I have.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives at the shattered Markov Manor, hanging apart over a chasm with a broken bridge of stepping stones.
timeline.quote: Jace stood at the end of a long arched bridge that jutted out from the mountainside.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace is briefly shown a vision of the manor as it once was; he cannot detect any mind causing it.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, he saw the place as it must have once been

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace uses telekinesis and balance to cross the floating stones to the entrance.
timeline.quote: He stepped off the edge of the bridge and planted his foot on a stone that hung in the air.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace enters the manor's archway, carved with monsters and a giant vampire.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the archway and the stone walls enfolded him.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: A voice breaks the silence in the entry hall, asking Jace why he came; he cannot find its source.
timeline.quote: "Why did you come here?" A voice breaks the silence.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace sees a memory of another living man in the hall and learns he is not the first living person there recently.
timeline.quote: I'm not the first living man to set foot in this hall recently.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace finds a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of petrified vampires embedded in the stone.
timeline.quote: Dozens and dozens of them, trapped and petrified and encased in the stone.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
timeline.quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace finds the dead man's stone face and the journal he clutches to his chest.
timeline.quote: It's wrapped in blue leather, held shut with a red and green strap of silk.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the journal was written by a moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa and that Jenrik took it over and was sent to the manor to die.
timeline.quote: after she entrusted the journal to him and sent him here.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
timeline.quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
timeline.quote: Sorin made her.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
timeline.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
timeline.quote: This will help me find Sorin.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Jenrik brought the journal, was about to be caught by the vampires, and that someone tore the castle apart and trapped them all in the walls.
timeline.quote: Jenrik came to the castle carrying the journal

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace leaves Markov Manor with the journal.
timeline.quote: I turn my back on the darkness, pass through the soaring entryway, and leave Markov Manor.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits Markov Manor and sends Sorin a clear message.
timeline.quote: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

citation.text: Declaration in Stone (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The destruction of Markov Manor makes the surviving Markovs more dangerous.
timeline.quote: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

citation.text: Markov Dreadknight (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace is sent to find Sorin and finds Markov Manor and evidence of a deeper mystery.
timeline.quote: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

citation.text: Foreboding Ruins (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: A drownyard, on the coast.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: he didn't survive it.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin.
timeline.quote: They called her the Harbinger.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
timeline.quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
timeline.quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
timeline.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
timeline.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges four more stone blades from white-hot stones.
timeline.quote: four blades, identical to the one she wielded, each one pulsing with energy of their stone forge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
timeline.quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
timeline.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
timeline.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
timeline.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
timeline.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
timeline.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
timeline.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
timeline.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor, burning with hatred for Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Burning with hatred for Nahiri, the Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor

citation.text: Bold Impaler (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad; Sorin is beaten and encased in stone by Nahiri, then abandoned by Olivia, who takes his sword.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn forces open the throne room doors and finds Sorin Markov reading on his broken throne.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov sits with one leg slung over the broken throne of his house.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
timeline.quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
timeline.quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
timeline.quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
timeline.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the Key and strikes Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops the attack, letting the group take the Key.
timeline.quote: Sigarda appeared, answering a prayer made by the group before entering the Manor, and stopped the attack

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks Arlinn when Avacyn is mentioned; Sigarda appears and stops him.
timeline.quote: Again she mentions Avacyn and is attacked again, but this time Sigarda appears and stops the attack.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds and takes the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's quarters.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the Key.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin goes into the family archives to wake his grandfather Edgar and ask for a plan.
timeline.quote: His grandfather had been slumbering for long enough.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin discovers that Edgar's mausoleum and coffin have been stolen.
timeline.quote: the coffin itself is missing

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
timeline.quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reads the invitation and declares the group will crash the wedding.
timeline.quote: "Looks like we've got a wedding to crash."

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline and the group help humans across Innistrad, then reluctantly return to Markov Manor and form a pact with Sorin.
timeline.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and the group form a pact with Sorin against Olivia.
timeline.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin and travelled together to the wedding of Olivia and Edgar Markov at the Voldaren estate.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia steals Edgar's coffin, wakes him and proposes; he agrees.
timeline.quote: The confused Edgar agreed to her marriage proposal.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks Olivia during the vows and Sigarda is freed, shattering the glass.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar and Sorin fight in the sanguitorium.
timeline.quote: the two came to blows as they hurled insults

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empowered Sorin overpowers Edgar and shows mercy, ordering him to leave.
timeline.quote: Sorin showed mercy and ordered his grandfather to leave.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her pack find Olivia and Edgar, who escape through a broken window.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri returns to Innistrad, restores Markov Manor and meets Ajani and Arlinn, who is hunting her.
timeline.quote: Having learned that Nahiri was on Arlinn's hit list, he placed himself between them to prevent them from fighting.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Stories in stone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A team of Arlinn, Teferi, Chandra, Kaya and Adeline obtains the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor and returns to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: obtained the Key from Markov Manor and returned to the Celestus

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Helvault's sundering Nahiri comes to Markov Manor seeking revenge on Sorin, and wrenches the manor from the mountainside.
timeline.quote: wrenching the entire structure and a massive chunk of bedrock from the mountainside

citation.text: "Markov Manor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires inside are trapped in the reshaped stone; Edgar survives and later marries Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: Edgar was thought to have perished in the attack, but he survived and later married Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Markov Manor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Sorin, the surviving Markovs are rallied to reclaim their ancestral seat.
timeline.quote: the surviving Markovs were rallied to reclaim their ancestral seat

citation.text: "Markov Manor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, furious at Sorin, attacks Markov Manor and imprisons its vampires in the walls.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor

citation.text: "The Travails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to his ruined home, sees Nahiri's message and seeks Olivia Voldaren's help.
timeline.quote: he sought help from the cunning Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "The Travails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin confronts Nahiri at Markov Manor and is defeated, encased in stone.
timeline.quote: Nahiri encased him in stone as poetic punishment

citation.text: "The Travails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: His ancestral home, but he has been unwelcome there for centuries.
relations.quote: He hasn't been welcome in Markov Manor for hundreds of years at least.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

relations.note: It is his ancestral home, where he is reportedly unwelcome.
relations.quote: Liliana had suggested that he wasn't particularly welcome in his ancestral home.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

relations.quote: Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

citation.text: Declaration in Stone (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: The manor was built by Edgar Markov

citation.text: "Markov Manor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
